description: Hatsun Agro Product Limited engages in the manufacture and marketing of milk, milk products, and cattle feed in India and internationally. The company offers ice cream, curd, panner, yoghurt, cheese spread, ghee, cooking and table butter, lassi, buttermilk, dairy whitener, skimmed milk powder, juice, and cocoa-based confectionery, as well as full cream, standardized, toned, and double toned milk. The company sells its products through stores under the Arun Icecreams, Arokya, Hatsun, HAP daily, Ibaco, Hanobar, Havia Chocolates, Milky Moo, Daily Moo, and Santosa brand names. Hatsun Agro Product Limited was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Chennai, India.
